overview: 本期共收录 12 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（10 篇）、国际贸易（1 篇）、风险管理与衍生品（1 篇）。方法上以均衡模型、贝叶斯方法为主。来源分布：arXiv（9 篇）、OpenAlex（2 篇）、Semantic Scholar（1 篇）。

papers.title: A Cournot–Nash model for a coupled hydrogen and electricity market
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  We present a novel model of a coupled hydrogen and electricity market on the intraday time scale, where hydrogen gas is used as a storage device for the electric grid. Electricity is produced by renewable energy sources or by extracting hydrogen from a pipeline that is shared by non-cooperative agents. The resulting model is a generalized Nash equilibrium problem. Under certain mild assumptions, we prove that an equilibrium exists. Perspectives for future work are presented.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】摘要  
我们提出了一个新颖的模型，该模型描述了日内时间尺度上氢能与电力市场的耦合机制。在该模型中，氢气被用作电网的储能介质。电力可通过可再生能源产生，或者通过从非合作主体共享的管道中提取氢气来获得。所构建的模型本质上是一个广义纳什均衡问题。在某些合理的假设条件下，我们证明了该均衡的存在性。同时，本文还探讨了未来研究的方向。。研究方法：均衡模型。

papers.title: Deep learning aging marker from retinal images unveils sex-specific clinical and genetic signatures
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  Retinal fundus images offer a non-invasive window into systemic aging. Here, we fine-tune a foundation model (RETFound) to predict chronological age from color fundus images in 71,343 participants from the UK Biobank, achieving a mean absolute error of 2.85 years. The resulting retinal age gap, i.e. the difference between predicted and chronological age, is associated with cardiometabolic traits, inflammation, cognitive performance, all-cause mortality, dementia, cancer, and incident cardiovascular disease. Genome-wide analyses identify genes related to longevity, metabolism, neurodegeneration, and age-related eye diseases. Sex-stratified models reveal consistent performance but divergent biological signatures: males have stronger links to metabolic syndrome, while in females, both model attention and genetics point to a greater involvement of retinal vasculature. Additional analyses indicate that retinal aging patterns in females vary across the menopausal transition, with postmenopausal females exhibiting higher retinal age gap values and clinical associations that more closely resemble those observed in males. Our study positions the retinal age gap as a biologically relevant and sex-specific phenotype associated with multiple aging-related diseases and outcomes beyond conventional risk factors, including chronological age.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】摘要  
视网膜眼底图像为研究全身性衰老提供了无创的途径。在本研究中，我们对一个基础模型（RETFound）进行了优化，使其能够根据英国生物银行（UK Biobank）中71,343名参与者的彩色眼底图像预测其实际年龄，平均绝对误差为2.85岁。预测得到的视网膜年龄与实际年龄之间的差异（即视网膜年龄差距）与多种生物学指标相关，包括心血管代谢特征、炎症反应、认知功能、全因死亡率、痴呆症、癌症以及新发心血管疾病。全基因组分析发现了与长寿、代谢过程、神经退行性疾病及年龄相关性眼病相关的基因。按性别分层后的模型显示了相似的预测性能，但生物学机制存在差异：男性与代谢综合征的关联更为紧密；而在女性中，模型分析和遗传学研究均表明视网膜血管系统在衰老过程中起着更重要的作用。进一步分析发现，女性的视网膜衰老模式在绝经期间存在变化，绝经后的女性表现出更大的视网膜年龄差距，并且其临床关联性与男性更为相似。我们的研究将视网膜年龄差距视为一种具有生物学意义的、与性别相关的表型，它与多种衰老相关疾病及结局有关，这些关联超出了传统风险因素的范畴。。

papers.title: The Dynamic Trade-Off of Dual-Class Shares
papers.abstract: Dual-class shares allocate control to founders whose firm-specific investments drive firm value but separate control from ownership, raising agency costs. We analyze this trade-off dynamically. Using new data on US dual-class firms spanning 52 years and difference-in-differences designs, we show that valuations rise following dual-class recapitalizations but decline over time, whereas innovative output increases persistently. These effects are concentrated in industries with greater firm-specific investments. We find corresponding results for stock unifications. Investment by mature dual-class firms is less sensitive to opportunities and voting premia increase with maturity. Our results support dynamic treatment effects and yield new policy implications.
papers.summary_zh: 【国际贸易】双重股权结构将控制权分配给那些对公司具有特定投资价值、从而推动公司价值增长的创始人，但同时将控制权与所有权分离，这导致了代理成本的出现。我们对这种权衡关系进行了动态分析。通过利用涵盖52年时间的美国双重股权企业的新数据以及差异-in-differences（DID）研究方法，我们发现双重股权重组后公司的估值会暂时上升，但随后会逐渐下降；然而，企业的创新产出却能够持续增加。这些效应在那些公司特定投资规模较大的行业中更为显著。对于股票合并的情况，我们也得出了类似的研究结果。成熟的双重股权企业的投资行为对市场机会的敏感度较低，且其投票权溢价会随着企业成熟度的提高而增加。我们的研究结果支持动态处理效应（dynamic treatment effects）的观点，并为相关政策制定提供了新的启示。。研究方法：双重差分。

papers.title: Potentials and Weak Potentials in Acyclic and Weakly Acyclic Games
papers.abstract: In a number of large, important families of finite games, not only is the set of pure-strategy Nash equilibria nonempty but it is also reachable from any initial strategy profile by some sequence of myopic single-player moves to a better or best-reply strategy. This weak acyclicity property is weaker than acyclicity of the game, which requires every such sequence to reach an equilibrium. For example, all perfect-information extensive-form games are weakly acyclic, but they are generally not acyclic as even sequences of best-improvement steps may cycle. Weak acyclicity is equivalent to acyclicity of some priority rule, which is a rule that allows only some improvement moves. It is also equivalent to the existence of a weak potential, which unlike a potential increases along some rather than every sequence as above.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】在许多大型、重要的有限博弈家族中，纯策略纳什均衡的集合不仅非空，而且从任何初始策略组合出发，通过一系列短视的单玩家决策，都可以逐步达到一个更优或最优的策略。这种“弱无环性”属性比博弈本身的无环性要求更为宽松——后者要求所有此类决策序列都必须最终达到均衡。例如，所有具有完美信息结构的扩展形式博弈都具备弱无环性，但它们通常并不满足严格的无环性，因为即使采取最优改进策略的序列也可能导致循环。弱无环性与某种“优先规则”的存在性等价；这种规则仅允许某些类型的改进动作。此外，它还等同于“弱势函数”的存在性——与传统的势函数不同，弱势函数在某些特定决策序列中会增加，而非在所有序列中都增加。。研究方法：均衡模型。

papers.title: Research on the Transformation and Upgrading Path of Traditional Enterprises from the Perspective of Cross-Boundary Innovation
papers.venue: Journal of Economics and Public Finance
papers.abstract: Cross-boundary innovation serves as a vital approach for traditional enterprises to break through development bottlenecks and realize transformation and upgrading amid a new round of scientific and technological revolution and industrial change. Set within the Chinese context, this paper first sorts out the theoretical connotation of cross-boundary innovation and systematically analyzes external environmental shifts and internal capability constraints confronting traditional enterprises in their transformation and upgrading. Further, it constructs a path framework for the cross-boundary transformation and upgrading of traditional enterprises from four dimensions: empowerment via technological cross-boundary innovation, transformation through service-oriented cross-boundary innovation, reconstruction enabled by platform-based cross-boundary innovation, and coordination driven by ecological cross-boundary innovation. This study reveals that cross-boundary innovation of traditional enterprises is not merely simple business diversification; instead, it represents a systematic reconstruction process anchored on core competencies, connected by digital technologies, and oriented toward value co-creation. On this basis, this paper proposes targeted strategic suggestions for traditional enterprises to implement cross-boundary innovation. The proposed framework enriches integrated research on traditional enterprises' transformation and upgrading. It also offers decision-making references for traditional enterprises with diverse resource endowments to advance cross-boundary innovation practices within China.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】跨界创新是传统企业突破发展瓶颈、在新一轮科技革命和产业变革中实现转型升级的重要途径。本文以中国背景为依托，首先厘清了跨界创新的理论内涵，并系统分析了传统企业在转型升级过程中面临的外部环境变化与内部能力制约。随后，从四个维度构建了传统企业跨界转型升级的路径框架：通过技术跨界创新实现能力提升、借助服务导向型跨界创新推动转型、依托平台化跨界创新进行重构，以及通过生态跨界创新促进协同发展。研究表明，传统企业的跨界创新并非简单的业务多元化，而是一个以核心竞争力为核心、以数字技术为纽带、以价值共创为导向的系统性重构过程。在此基础上，本文为传统企业实施跨界创新提出了针对性的战略建议。该框架丰富了关于传统企业转型升级的综合性研究，并为资源禀赋多样的传统企业在我国推进跨界创新实践提供了决策参考。。

papers.title: Efficient tensor bases for pairwise comparisons
papers.abstract: In this study, we construct the first orthogonal basis for additively consistent subspace in pairwise comparisons theory. This construction is based on our representation of additively consistent best approximations of skew-symmetric matrices with respect to a tensor basis having minimal support. The orthogonal basis establishes the logarithmic consistent projection for the orthogonal windowing of pairwise comparisons matrices. It is compared with the windowing of the Saaty and SVD types. These comparisons resulted in new composite formulae for logarithmic, Saaty, and SVD projections. The theoretical considerations presented in the paper are accompanied by numerous examples.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】在本研究中，我们首次为成对比较理论中具有加性一致性的子空间构建了一个正交基。该构建方法基于我们对斜对称矩阵的加性一致最佳逼近的表示，这些逼近是相对于具有最小支撑集的张量基而言的。所构建的正交基为成对比较矩阵的正交窗口化提供了对数一致性投影方法。我们将这种方法与Satty方法和SVD方法的窗口化进行了比较。这些比较结果推导出了对数投影、Satty投影和SVD投影的新复合公式。本文提出的理论观点辅以了大量实例进行说明。。

papers.title: Cross-Section Estimation of Long-Run Relations Using Time-Compressed Data
papers.abstract: Many empirical investigations of long-run relations are based on cross-section regressions in averaged or long differenced data that effectively have the time dimension of a $T\times N$ panel compressed. We analyze a class of time-compressed I(1) data and show that they have magnified variability stemming from the fact that the cross-section variance of a non-stationary panel `fans out' with time. Cross-section regressions in time compressed data can potentially yield estimates that are super-consistent and asymptotically normal, whether the regressors are stationary, non-stationary, or highly persistent. The fastest convergence rate of $\sqrt{N}T$ requires a compression scheme that not only magnifies the non-stationary signal, but also dilutes the regression noise. Omitted fixed effects preclude noise dilution but the estimates remain super-consistent. However, the fanning out effect can be weakened when the data have a strong force for mean-reversion or convergence, a problem that seems relevant for temperature data. We consider three applications and find that the long-run relation between consumption and income, and between growth/inflation and demographic variables are reasonably well determined, but the estimated relation between growth and warming temperature is fragile.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】许多关于长期关系的实证研究都是基于对平均化或长期差分数据的横截面回归分析，这些数据实际上将时间维度压缩成了一个$T\times N$的面板结构。我们研究了一类时间压缩的I(1)数据，并发现其变异性被放大了，这是因为非平稳面板的横截面方差会随时间“扩散”（即方差值随时间增加）。无论回归变量是平稳的、非平稳的还是具有高度持久性的，对时间压缩数据进行横截面回归都可能得到超一致（即估计值在不同样本间高度一致）且渐近正态的估计结果。最快的收敛速度为$\sqrt{N}T$，但这需要一种既能放大非平稳信号又能稀释回归噪声的压缩方法。如果忽略固定效应，则无法实现噪声的稀释，但估计结果仍然保持超一致性。然而，当数据具有强烈的均值回归或收敛趋势时，这种“扩散”效应会减弱，这一问题在温度数据研究中显得尤为突出。我们通过三个具体案例发现：消费与收入之间的长期关系，以及增长/通货膨胀与人口变量之间的长期关系都得到了较为可靠的估计；但增长与温度升高之间的长期关系则显得较为脆弱（即估计结果的稳定性较差）。。研究方法：固定效应、横截面分析、回归分析。

papers.title: Output-Only Identification and Spectral Monitoring of Coupled Feedback Networks with Known Time-Varying Actuation
papers.abstract: Coupled feedback networks are often monitored channel by channel even though cross-channel paths alter both stability margins and transmitted disturbances. We study identification of a structured feedback matrix L_t = Phi diag(gamma_t) in an output-only setting: no commanded, probing, or reference input exists -- only temporally separated outputs and the scheduling gains gamma_t are observed, while the coupling response Phi and the clearing-window inputs are not. Identification rests jointly on the persistent excitation of the observed pre-window output and on two structural features separating coupling from confounds: the known time variation of the gains, which modulates the closed-loop response in a predictable pattern, and a partial-reversal moment by which a known fraction of transient displacement is corrected in a subsequent window. We give a hierarchy of results: exact local identification of the coupling under a Jacobian rank condition on the gain regimes; a first-order interaction estimator whose identification strength is the minimum eigenvalue of the residualized interaction information matrix (provably unidentified under constant gains); and a characterization of the estimand as a resolvent sensitivity -- the right object for screening transmitted disturbances and a first-stage input to spectral-margin recovery -- with sqrt(T) asymptotics for the first-order estimator, a cross-identification theorem mapping each varying gain to exactly identified resolvent rows and columns, and bootstrap validity under consistent selection; the implemented heuristic's empirical coverage (90% at nominal 95%) quantifies the remaining gap. Simulations verify sharpness of the rank condition and quantify benchmark failures under confounding. A case study on leveraged-fund rebalancing feedback, where daily fund disclosures play the role of the known gains, illustrates the method on real data.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】尽管跨通道路径会同时影响系统的稳定性裕度和传输干扰，但耦合反馈网络通常仍需要逐通道进行监测。我们研究在仅输出信号的环境下对结构化反馈矩阵 \( L_t = \Phi \diag(\gamma_t) \) 的识别问题：该环境中不存在指令输入、探测信号或参考输入，仅能观测到时间上分离的输出信号以及调度增益 \( \gamma_t \)；而耦合响应矩阵 \( \Phi \) 和清除窗口内的输入数据则无法获取。这种识别方法依赖于两个关键因素：一是观测到的预窗口输出信号的持续激励特性；二是能够区分耦合效应与其它干扰因素的结构特征。具体来说，这些特征包括：增益的已知时间变化规律（该规律以可预测的方式影响闭环系统的响应）；以及一种“部分反转机制”——即在后续窗口中能够纠正部分瞬态位移的现象。我们提出了以下研究成果：1. 在增益满足特定雅可比秩条件的情况下，能够实现耦合效应的精确局部识别；2. 提出了一种一阶交互作用估计器，其识别精度取决于残差交互信息矩阵的最小特征值（在增益恒定的情况下该估计器无法被准确识别）；3. 将待估计量描述为“解析灵敏度”（一种适用于检测传输干扰和恢复系统频域裕度的工具...。研究方法：数值模拟。

papers.title: Nonparametric Bayesian Inference for Partially Identified Discrete Response Models
papers.abstract: This paper proposes a nonparametric Bayesian inference framework for partially identified discrete response models. The key observation is that these models map a reduced-form conditional choice probability to an identified set. Consequently, nonparametric Bayesian inference for the conditional probability mass function leads to Bayesian inference for the identified set. The inference framework nests conditional moment inequalities and linear systems with unknown coefficients as special cases. Importantly, our proposal does not require converting conditional moments into unconditional moments or discretizing covariates. We show that the posterior is consistent for the true identified set when the model is correctly specified, show that the posterior can consistently detect model misspecification, and show posterior consistency for a pseudo-identified set that is valid under misspecification. We also verify the assumptions for a class of priors based on Gaussian processes that we use to implement our proposal. These priors offer similar flexibility to frequentist partial identification methods, and are computationally attractive because posterior sampling can be performed in closed-form. We also show that many of the ideas in this paper extend to continuous responses and aggregated discrete responses (e.g., market shares).
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本文提出了一种用于部分识别离散响应模型的非参数贝叶斯推断框架。其核心思想在于：这类模型将条件选择概率的简化形式映射到一个可识别的集合上。因此，通过对条件概率质量函数进行非参数贝叶斯推断，即可实现对该可识别集合的推断。该推断框架将条件矩不等式及含有未知系数的线性系统视为特例进行处理。重要的是，我们的方法无需将条件矩转换为无条件矩，也无需对协变量进行离散化处理。我们证明了：当模型设定正确时，后验分布对于真实的可识别集合是一致的；同时能够可靠地检测模型设定错误的情况；此外，在模型设定错误的情况下，对于某些仍具有识别意义的“伪可识别集合”，后验分布也依然保持一致性。我们还验证了用于实现该方法的基于高斯过程的先验假设的合理性。这些先验与频率主义方法在灵活性上具有相似之处，并且在计算上具有优势（因为后验抽样可以以封闭形式进行）。此外，本文中的许多方法同样适用于连续响应变量以及聚合后的离散响应变量（例如市场份额）。。研究方法：贝叶斯方法。

papers.title: Agnostic Sequential Rationality
papers.abstract: Agnostic sequential equilibrium (ASE) is a refinement of sequential equilibrium that does not force on the players a single, arbitrary belief system. In addition, whereas sequential equilibrium assumes the players' beliefs to be fully consistent (a notion that is based on perturbations of strategies), ASE employs a novel, simpler and local concept of strong consistency between strategy profiles and off-equilibrium beliefs, which is applicable to a large class of dynamic games, including games with a continuum of actions. In the last respect, the new solution concept is similar to perfect Bayesian equilibrium. It is shown that a strategy profile in an imperfect-information extensive-form game with perfect recall is an ASE precisely when it is a sequential equilibrium with every fully consistent belief system. ASE is generalized by the set-valued solution concept of agnostic sequential polyequilibrium, which allows leaving the players' actions in some information sets partially or completely unspecified.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】不可知序贯均衡（Agnostic Sequential Equilibrium, ASE）是对传统序贯均衡的一种改进，它不强制玩家遵循某种单一的、任意的信念体系。与传统序贯均衡假设玩家信念完全一致（这一假设基于策略的微小变动）不同，ASE采用了一种新的、更简单且更具局部性的概念——即策略组合与非均衡信念之间的“强一致性”。这种概念适用于广泛的动态博弈类型，包括那些包含连续行动选择的博弈。在这一点上，ASE的新解概念与完美贝叶斯均衡（Perfect Bayesian Equilibrium）具有相似性。研究表明：在一个具有完美记忆能力（perfect recall）的不完全信息扩展形式博弈（extensive-form game）中，当某个策略组合同时满足所有完全一致的信念体系时，它就构成了一个ASE。ASE的概念还可以通过“不可知序贯多均衡”（Agnostic Sequential Polyequilibrium）这一集值解概念得到进一步推广；该概念允许对某些信息集中的玩家行动进行部分或完全的模糊处理（即不具体指定其行动内容）。。研究方法：贝叶斯方法、均衡模型。

papers.title: Endogenous Selection and Spillovers: Bayesian Inference for Policy-Relevant Causal Effects
papers.abstract: This paper develops a new econometric framework to identify and estimate policy-relevant causal effects in contexts with endogenous selection into treatment and spillovers within single large networks or spatial settings. Conventional causal inference methods relying on either unconfoundedness or no-interference assumptions are generally inadequate in these scenarios. We introduce a Spillover Roy model that jointly models endogenous treatment selection and potential outcomes while allowing spillovers through a low-dimensional exposure mapping of neighbors' treatments. The model captures heterogeneous treatment responses across levels of latent resistance to treatment and neighborhood exposure. Within this framework, we define policy-relevant direct, spillover, and total effects under feasible policy changes and show that the total effect decomposes into a direct component from policy-induced participation and a spillover component from policy-induced changes in neighborhood treatment exposure. For estimation and inference, we develop a Bayesian data-augmentation algorithm with parameter expansion that enables efficient posterior computation and coherent uncertainty quantification for heterogeneous causal effects and policy counterfactuals. An application to the U.S. Opportunity Zones program finds positive direct effects on housing development but limited spillover benefits, while counterfactual policy analysis reveals diminishing returns from program expansion.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本文构建了一个新的计量经济学框架，用于识别和估计在存在内生治疗选择效应以及单一大型网络或空间环境中政策相关因果效应的情景。传统的因果推断方法（这些方法依赖于无混杂性或无干扰假设）在这些情况下通常难以有效发挥作用。我们提出了一个“溢出效应Roy模型”（Spillover Roy Model），该模型能够同时考虑内生治疗选择和潜在结果，并通过低维的邻居治疗映射机制来捕捉溢出效应。该模型能够反映不同个体对治疗的抵抗程度以及邻里环境对治疗效果的异质性影响。在该框架下，我们定义了在可行政策变化下的政策相关直接效应、溢出效应和总效应，并指出总效应可以分解为政策引发的参与效应（直接效应）和政策引发的邻里治疗环境变化效应（溢出效应）。为了进行估计和推断，我们开发了一种基于贝叶斯方法的数据增强算法，该算法通过参数扩展实现了高效的后续计算，并能够对异质性因果效应和政策反事实结果进行一致的不确定性量化。通过对美国“机会区计划”（U.S. Opportunity Zones Program）的应用研究，我们发现该计划对住房发展具有积极的直接促进作用，但溢出效应较为有限；同时，反事实政策分析表明，随着计划...。研究方法：因果推断、贝叶斯方法。

papers.title: Normative boundaries of AI in scientific work: Evidence from PhD researchers
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly embedded in scientific work, but researchers may not evaluate its use uniformly across research tasks. This study examines task-specific attitudes towards AI among an international, self-selected sample of 3,785 PhD students in STEM and medical and health sciences who participated in Nature's Graduate Survey 2025. We analyse respondents' comfort with using AI for writing a research article, collecting and analysing data, designing experiments, tracking scientific literature, and summarising it. Latent class analysis identifies four distinct attitudinal profiles. The dominant profile reflects a "division of labour," in which AI is widely accepted for literature-related tasks but resisted in activities closely associated with intellectual contribution, such as writing, data analysis, and experimental design. A "status quo" profile is broadly uncomfortable across tasks, an "all-purpose" profile is broadly comfortable, and an "undecided" profile expresses substantial uncertainty. These patterns suggest that attitudes towards AI in research are organised less around a simple acceptance-rejection divide than around task-specific boundaries, likely concerning delegation, authorship, and responsibility. Because the survey measures comfort rather than legitimacy, the profiles are best interpreted as attitudinal configurations with a normative dimension. The findings highlight the importance of task-specific approaches to AI governance, doctoral training, disclosure, and research evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】人工智能（AI）在科学研究中的应用日益广泛，但研究人员在评估其使用效果时可能存在差异。本研究调查了3,785名来自STEM（科学、技术、工程和数学）以及医学与健康科学领域的博士生对AI的态度，这些博士生自愿参与了《自然》杂志2025年的研究生调查。我们分析了他们在使用AI撰写研究论文、收集与分析数据、设计实验、追踪科学文献以及对其进行总结等任务中的接受程度。通过潜在类别分析，我们发现了四种不同的态度类型：  

1. **“劳动分工”型**：这类受访者普遍接受AI在文献相关任务中的应用，但在需要创造性思维或深度分析的任务（如写作、数据分析和实验设计）中则持抵制态度；  
2. **“现状维持型**：这类受访者在所有任务中对AI的使用都感到不适；  
3. **“多功能型**：这类受访者对AI的使用持积极态度；  
4. **“犹豫不决型**：这类受访者对AI的使用态度存在较大不确定性。  

这些结果表明，人们对AI在研究中的态度并非简单地分为接受与拒绝两类，而是受到任务特性的影响，这些特性可能与任务分配、作者身份和责任归属等问题密切相关。由于该调查衡量的是使用AI的舒适度而非其...。研究方法：实验方法、调查数据。
